overview: Docket (1930-31) lists papers on resuming and financing Taiwan's Sun Moon Lake hydroelectric project, including Governor-General support, loans, and possible contracts.

people.role: Author of a referenced dispatch from Japan; U.S. Ambassador to Japan

people.name: Franklin
people.role: Reporting officer associated with a telegram from Amoy

subfiles.title: List of papers on resuming the Lake Candidius hydroelectric project
subfiles.about: An index sheet summarizes correspondence about reviving the Lake Candidius hydroelectric project and identifying firms able to undertake construction and supply equipment.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: Taihoku reported the Lake Candidius project would resume, seeking 40 million yen in foreign loans within three years.

subfiles.title: List of papers and cross-references on Taiwan Power Company financing
subfiles.about: An index sheet lists reports and cross-references concerning the Taiwan Power Company loan, the Sun Moon Lake project, colonial political changes, and American bond financing.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: Cabinet approved Taiwan Power Company loans, plus cross-references to Morgan bond financing and a Finance Department loan.

interest: Shows 1930-31 reporting on financing Taiwan's Sun Moon Lake hydroelectric project.
